mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, note_name AS noteName, note_content AS noteContent, creat_time AS creatTime FROM knowledge_base WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ( note_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR note_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY creat_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, note_name AS noteName, note_content AS noteContent, creat_time AS creatTime FROM knowledge_base WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY creat_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base ( user_id, note_name, note_content, creat_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{noteName}, #{noteContent}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base SET note_name = #{noteName}, note_content = #{noteContent}, creat_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
